executable.title: List Tubules (IDs)
executable.description: Fetch the latest 'tubules' annotation and optionally publish a copy with per-element labels set to their element id (so IDs show in the DSA viewer).

image.name: input_file
image.label: Item or File ID
image.description: Item _id or File _id that contains the tubules annotation (file or item)

file.name: out
file.label: Output JSON
file.description: Optional path to save the listing (downloadable as job output)

boolean.name: publish_annotation
boolean.label: Publish Id-Labeled Annotation
boolean.description: If true, post a copy of the annotation with each element's label set to its element id so IDs show in the viewer.

parameters.label: Girder (Optional)
parameters.description: Provide to enable fetching/publishing annotations via a Girder/DSA instance

string.name: girderToken
string.label: Girder API Token
string.description: Your Girder API token (use girder REST API doc to generate one)
